requests.prompt:
You are choosing which model omp (a coding agent) uses for each of its model roles, for the user of OMPdesk.

## Candidate models
Use only these models, written exactly as listed (`provider/id`):
- anthropic/a (provider anthropic; name "A"; context window 1M tokens; $3 input / $15 output per 1M tokens; catalog intelligence score 61)
- openai/b (provider openai; context window 400K tokens)

The user's current default model is anthropic/a.

## Roles
### Conversation
- default (Default): The main model: it answers every conversation turn and does the coding work unless another role takes over.
- smol (Fast): Fast, cheap model for lightweight work (quick lookups, small edits, the model `prewalk` hands implementation to). Speed and price matter more than depth.

### Agent work
- advisor (Advisor): Second-opinion reviewer: passively reviews every turn of the main agent and injects notes (concerns, blockers). Ideally a strong model from a different vendor than the default model, so it catches different mistakes. It only runs while the advisor is enabled.

### Other roles
- reviewer (Reviewer): Reviewer (chat role)

## Task
1. Research current public benchmarks and comparisons for exactly these models: use web_search, then read the most relevant pages. Prefer recent, reputable sources (vendor model cards, independent leaderboards such as coding and agentic benchmarks, price and speed comparisons). Do not research other models.
2. Decide group by group, so a group's roles fit together: within Conversation, Fast is the cheapest and quickest, Thinking the strongest, Default in between. For each role, pick the candidate that best fits its purpose, weighing capability, speed and price. Leave a role out when no candidate fits it; an omitted role keeps its current model.
3. Decide whether the advisor should be enabled: it is worth it when a strong candidate from a different vendor than the default model is available.

## Reply
Reply with ONLY one JSON object: no prose before or after it, no code fence. Shape:
{"assignments":[{"role":"<role id>","model":"<provider/id>","reason":"<one sentence>"}],"advisor":{"enable":<true or false>,"reason":"<one sentence>"},"sources":[{"title":"<page title>","url":"<https URL>"}],"notes":"<optional, one or two sentences>"}
- "role" is one of: default, smol, advisor, reviewer.
- "model" is one of: anthropic/a, openai/b.
- "sources" lists the pages you actually used.
- Write every "reason" and "notes" in Korean.
